COMPLETE
  ✓ BT-85 acceptance: add a real make cover-check gate using go test ./... -count=1 -short -coverprofile=<tmp>; enforce total >=80% and every non-exempt package >=60%, with named reasoned exemption for statement-less internal/secretscheck. Make the gate load-bearing: pass at current coverage and forced failure (for example min-package 95) naming the offending package. Add hermetic checker unit tests for total/package below floor, exemption, empty/malformed profile, exact boundary. CI runs the same command as make cover-check, README documents target/floors/exemptions. Preserve all existing build/vet/full-test/fmt/version/spec/vuln gates and leave no generated artifacts.: Gate: Makefile:108-113 defines COVER_MIN_TOTAL ?= 80, COVER_MIN_PACKAGE ?= 60 and cover-check running `go test ./... -count=1 -short -coverprofile=$$tmp/coverage.out` (mktemp -d + trap rm) then `go run ./cmd/covercheck --min-total=$(COVER_MIN_TOTAL) --min-package=$(COVER_MIN_PACKAGE) --exempt=internal/secretscheck`. Load-bearing proof: `make cover-check` -> exit 0, output 'covercheck: total 83.1% of statements (floor 80.0%) / lowest package internal/describe 66.5% (floor 60.0%) / exempt internal/secretscheck: not present in profile (zero statements, exempt by policy) / PASS: 14 packages evaluated'; `make cover-check COVER_MIN_PACKAGE=95` -> exit 1 with 13 findings naming packages (e.g. 'FAIL package github.com/coding-hermes/boardctl/internal/describe coverage 66.5% is below floor 95.0%'). Exemption is named+reasoned in internal/covercheck/covercheck.go package doc and printed via Report.Exemptions (covercheck.go:150-160). Hermetic tests: `go test -count=1 -v ./internal/covercheck ./cmd/covercheck` -> all PASS, covering TestCovercheckEvaluateTotalBelowFloor, TestCovercheckEvaluatePackageBelowFloorNamesPackage (asserts message names pkg + 62.5%), TestCovercheckEvaluateExemptZeroStatementPackage, TestCovercheckParseProfileErrors (empty/whitespace/header-only/missing mode/malformed blocks), TestCovercheckEvaluateExactBoundaryPasses (62.5/81.25 exact pass, one statement short flips both findings), TestCovercheckCommandForcedStrictFloorExitsOne (--min-package 95 -> exit 1), TestCovercheckCommandUsageAndIOErrorsExitTwo, TestCovercheckFloorsComeOnlyFromFlags. CI: .github/workflows/ci.yml 'Coverage' step `run: make cover-check` (same target, floors in one place). README:1555 and README:1655-1685 document the target, 80%/60% floors, the internal/secretscheck exemption and the COVER_MIN_PACKAGE=95 override. Preserved gates verified: `go build ./...` BUILD_OK, `go vet ./...` VET_OK, `go test -count=1 -short ./...` all 15 packages ok, TestGofmt ok, TestVersioncheck ok, ./internal/speccheck ok, TestVulncheck ok. No artifacts: `git status --porcelain` shows only harness files (.coding-hermes/board/*.jsonl, .gitreins/history/); no coverage.out anywhere (profile lives in mktemp dir removed by trap).
